Deleting a pre-existing DB matches instruction.md:15 'start with no shipped database'. Versus template solve.sh (mkdir + cp -a only) the additions are task-local and stay inside /app. RUNTIME CONTRACT: entry /app/server.js -> require('./src/index.js') (server.js:2); bootstrap.js:43 listens on Number(process.env.PORT || 3000) on 0.0.0.0 and answers GET /api/health and /health before any DB work (bootstrap.js:20-23), matching instruction.md:13 and integration.md:5-10; db.js:9 DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || /app/app.db (path.join(__dirname,'..','app.db')), WAL beside it; seedIfEmpty (db.js:61-62) skips when users exist, so restarts never reseed (integration.md:8-9).
